meaning: Visible projected ribbon courses. Widths are reference pixels, not physical thickness. Endpoints are construction ports, not strand ends. No hidden connections or depth order are established.
parameterization: u is normalized distance along the visible guide; v from -1 to 1 keeps a fixed position across the ribbon. Left/right use the guide direction. Width stations are full widths, interpolated with smoothstep.

reserveRule: Ownership applies only to U3 material outside all original territories. Bounding rectangles are selectors, not fill geometry. Ownership does not extend ribbon rails or authorize thread generation there. Material without an owner remains explicitly unresolved; U1/U2 depth stays provisional.
